notes.title: FLAKE: The Legend of Snowblind - release date
notes.notes:
Dear friends, adventurers and point and clickers

We are excited to announce that FLAKE is ready for his first adventure.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44816663/865ce23f2e76801da14d9e1b0f5dcd065dd77a20.jpg

It took some time (years) and effort but finally day is closing in.
Hand drawn animations, more then 20 fully voiced characters, aprox five hours of gameplay (with knowing the puzzles), original soundtrack and lot of love and commitment. ;)

Thank you for your support.

Dux
